name: Shanghai Zijiang Enterprise Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Zijiang Enterprise Group Co., Ltd. operates in the packaging industry in China and internationally. The company offers PET performs and bottles, crown caps and labels, plastic tamper-evident caps, OEM beverage products, metallized paper and cardboard products, films, coating materials, colored paper packaging products, and other new packaging materials. It also engages in the real estate and venture capital businesses; import and export of goods and technologies; and packaging printing and warehousing activities. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
